From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>

Subject: Monthly stage audit + leadership binder intake (Aug cycle)

Hi all,

Time for our monthly stage audit and leadership binder intake for the Aug cycle. Please do the following by EOD Thursday Aug 13 (PDT):

1) Open the attached stage_master_sheet.xlsx and verify stage for each deal you own. Update: stage, commit? (yes/no), committed ARR, and primary blocker.
2) Flag any deals you want pulled into the leadership binder with a short 2–3 line rationale in the "Binder" column.
3) Upload any supporting docs (pricing notes, signed LOIs, procurement ETA) to the Drive folder below or attach to your reply.

Guidance for the binder: limit to 1 slide per deal, 3 bullets (status, ask, risk/mitigation), and clearly call out if this is a commit. Markus will be compiling slides into the leadership pack — please keep slide owners sticky to yourself.

Links and refs:
- HubSpot deal (use this to confirm ARR): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-12345
- Drive folder (binder intake): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/leadership-binders-aug-2026
- Template for slides is in the Drive folder (leadership_slide_template.pptx)

If you hit procurement evidence gaps, loop finance@redwood.com and ping me. If a deal cannot be verified by the deadline, mark it as "Needs review" and add a short reason.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
